coordinateSpace: editorial half-court layout units, depth from attacking baseline then width from far sideline
method: Assistant visual review of the three exact held source frames. Visible lane corners guide court orientation; player spacing is edited from visible feet and relative body positions. This is not calibrated court reconstruction or tracking.
limitations: Body-only players retain their original body brackets; no hidden source-image foot anchor is invented.
Schematic positions are rounded and separated for readability; they are not measured feet or official coordinates.
Only the existing annotated visible players are included: nine in T1, three highlighted in T3, nine in T2.
Direction arrows describe short editorial action directions, not player trajectories.
The 3.2-unit inset contains the largest active marker including its pulsing outer ring.
